title.en: The British Shorthair's coat needs grooming at least once a week.
title.sl: Britanska kratkodlaka mačka potrebuje nego dlake vsaj enkrat na teden.

why.en: That's why you brush your cat once a week in the app.
why.sl: Zato v aplikaciji svojo muco češeš enkrat na teden.

facts.source_name: VCA Animal Hospitals ("the Veterinarians of VCA Animal Hospitals"), undated
facts.quote: Run a comb through its coat at least weekly to keep it mat-free and looking healthy.
facts.verified_by: generate-breed-facts.mjs (numbers and terms checked against the quote)
